cohort: The study included 108 infants who were all under 48 hours old and whose demographic data, delivery methods, gestational age, and family background were collected.
finding: A moderate positive correlation (r=0.46) was discovered between foot length and birth weight among the newborns.
mod_finding: Caesarean section, specifically Lower Segment Caesarean Delivery, was identified as the most frequent delivery method among the study participants.
birth_weight: The most common birth weight range was 2.3-2.5 kg, and average birth weights were reported as 4.28 kg and 4.82 kg for two unspecified groups, with most neonates close to the upper limit of the low-birth-weight category.
